reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 000998 (the melody read from 000998a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. CCEH's page spells John Henry Gower as “John M. Gower”; the name is printed as the sources spell it. John Henry Gower's dates (1855–1922) are from https://hymnary.org/tune/meditation_gower (MEDITATION, 1890, by John H. Gower; hymnals there print 'John Henry Gower, 1855-1922'; https://hymnary.org/hymn/CCEH/998 is the one credit as 'John M. Gower', so CCEH miswrites his middle initial); https://hymnary.org/person/Gower_JH (Gower, John H., 1855-1922); https://id.loc.gov/authorities/names/no2013099885 (Gower, John H., 1855-1922; born Rugby 1855, died Denver, Colorado, July 30, 1922; tune Meditation); CCEH's page gives only the year 1890. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000998a.nwc).
